class.name: Steamworks
class.brief_description: Accesses Steam features from an existing Godot owner.
class.description: Call [method boot] on the main thread to use Steam features independently of the game runtime. The existing scene-tree owner controls the lifetime of the internal Steam callback client. The facade and its typed services belong to that attachment and retire when it exits or loses its native client generation. Boot returns a facade even if startup fails. Read [method boot_result] for the startup diagnostic. Direct actions report their own availability. Typed accessors may return null when the client or requested service is unavailable.

method.name: boot
method.description: Attaches the internal Steam client beneath a live scene-tree owner on the main thread. With null settings, accepts the launch AppID. The returned facade retains the attachment outcome, including a missing runtime, invalid settings, or unsupported build.

method.name: boot_result
method.description: Returns the original startup result. Use [method is_ready] when a view needs to observe current availability.

method.name: restart_through_steam_if_needed
method.description: Opt into Valve's relaunch check before starting any Steam runtime. Supply a shipping AppID. [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP] means the process should quit while Steam starts the installed copy. The shared Spacewar AppID is rejected.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns whether this attachment still owns a live Steam client generation.

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the AppID verified by Steam for this attachment, or zero if unavailable.

method.name: is_online
method.description: Returns whether the exact attached client currently has a live connection to Steam. Offline Mode can still expose cached features when [method is_ready] is true.

method.name: get_local_steam_id
method.description: Returns the signed-in SteamID64 as a decimal string, or an empty string if unavailable.

method.name: open_achievements
method.description: Requests the Achievements pane using the attached Steam overlay. Success means the request was submitted. A busy result means the overlay is still loading, disabled, or inaccessible from this thread. A failed startup or detached scope returns its diagnostic. Observe the overlay to confirm display.

method.name: achievements
method.description: Returns the single-achievement action facade for this attachment. Its unlock action submits storage and carries the original startup error when no stats service was attached.

signal.name: runtime_lost
signal.description: Emitted after an IPC failure retires the exact native client generation and invalidates its retained services. To recover a standalone scope, defer a fresh [method boot] until the callback returns.
